# The Future of Budgeting Basics — fundamentals self-quiz (Advanced, public edition)
# Run: python3 quiz.py
qa = [
    ("What is Sinking fund?", "the planned saving for a known future bill"),
    ("What is Sinking funds?", "saving monthly for known big expenses"),
    ("State one governing principle of budgeting basics.", "Give every dollar a job."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    print(f"A{i}: {a}")
    score += 1
print(f"Quiz complete: reviewed {score} of {len(qa)} key points.")
